correctness.rationale: I read RESULT.md and the complete independent combinatorial checker. Each of the twelve icosahedral vertices has five vertices at distance two and exactly one antipode at distance three. The distance-two graph has thirty edges and is isomorphic to the icosahedral graph under the explicitly supplied vertex permutation; all twenty triangles form an orientable two-sphere (links are five-cycles, Euler characteristic 12-30+20=2). All six antipodal pairs are isolated in the independence complex one-skeleton outside this sphere: no independent triple contains an antipodal edge and there is no independent four-set. Independent direct face enumeration gave (12,36,20,0). Attaching six edges to the simply connected sphere yields S2∨6S1 and integral torsion-free H1=Z6,H2=Z. The long exact sequence of (K,B) gives a canonical signed-permutation basis for H1 and corresponding outer free-group action; top orientation under rotations is + and the free antipodal involution acts by - on S2. The inspected checker enumerates all 120 graph automorphisms, validates the orientation and signed chord character (6,-2,0,1) across A5 orders, and independently checks modular boundary ranks. This proves the rational W6 x epsilon and trivial x epsilon modules via A5 character table; modular calculations are corroborative, not used for integral homotopy.
